summary: npm package ships a phishing HTML page with no installer-reachable code
details: The tarball contains a single file, index.html, which is a fake Cloudflare 'Just a moment...' Turnstile challenge page with an obfuscator.io-style string-array routine (function _0x5d4a) inlined in the body and a loader referencing challenges.cloudflare.com/turnstile/v0/api.js. package.json declares no lifecycle scripts (no preinstall/install/postinstall/prepare) and sets main to index.html, which Node cannot require or import. Installing or requiring this package executes no code on the installer's machine; the obfuscated payload is browser-side and only reaches a victim if the HTML is served from somewhere else. The package appears to abuse the npm registry as static file hosting for a phishing lure rather than attack developers who install it.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
